claim: The 2024 Mihintale stele transmits a linked tradition of Thuparama, Sanghamitta, the Bodhi-tree transfer and the establishment of the bhikkhuni order.
bounded_by: The commemorative text bundles several institutions and episodes; each requires separate textual or material anchoring before being treated as independently established history.
notes: Promoted from GF-MIH-05 in Run27; intentionally preserves the bundle as transmitted tradition rather than collapsing it into a single proven event.
